{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|U.S Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Louisiana Creole cuisine|Louisiana Creole cuisine]]

This is a dish for company or a special occasion. It is large enough for a luncheon entrée; it may also be served as an appetizer. The dish is well known by habitués of Galatoire's Restaurant on Bourbon Street, New Orleans. 

==Ingredients==

*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Béchamel_Sauce_Louisiannaise|Béchamel Sauce Louisiannaise]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:White Pepper|White pepper]] to taste
*1 small bunch [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 tbsp butter, room temperature
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (about 0.5 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) jumbo or regular-size fresh white lump [[Cookbook:Crab|crab meat]] (from the body only, not the claws)
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
*2 tbsp fine [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
*4 slices [[Cookbook:Toast|toast]]
*1 tsp flat-leaf [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], finely chopped
*1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], cut into wedges 

==Procedure==

#Pick over crabmeat carefully with your fingers to assure the absence of crab shell. This is necessary.
#[[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] green onions in butter over medium heat until soft. Do not allow onions to brown.
#Add white lumpfish crab meat, then [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in béchamel sauce. When mixture begins to [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]], remove from heat and fold in beaten egg yolks. 
#Refrigerate mixture for 10 minutes in order to form canapés. Or, let stay in refrigerator overnight until ready to use.
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350 °F (190 °C).
#Combine breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese in a mixing bowl.
#Trim the ends of the toast. Place trimmed toast on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] and spoon refrigerated crabmeat mixture onto toast using an ice-cream scoop.
#Sprinkle canapés with breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese mixture. Dot each canapé with soft butter.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] canapés for 20 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] each serving with flat-leaf parsley and a wedge of lemon.
